baseline.holdoutRule: The v1-v19 holdouts are regression cases and retain their labels. Existing 95% image-exactness, 90% confirmed-return recall and zero wrong-channel thresholds remain unchanged. Two fresh real photos were selected and pixel-reviewed after the candidate code was frozen and before either image was submitted to a model: a Return Right machine beside a cart containing many bagged beverage bottles, and a supermarket display containing many co-equal paper beverage cartons with visible product barcodes. Neither photo establishes one container as the subject, and neither may produce a confirmed or conditional return action. Both holdouts must remain not_sure with no next action and pass all safety assertions. Positive utility remains gated by the retained real-image confirmed-return regressions and the 90% recall threshold; no unsuitable image was relabelled as a fresh positive. These are developer-visible, frozen, non-adaptive checks, not sealed blind tests. Every complete run checks all sources for near duplicates at 0.995 before any model call.

invariants: Only containers carrying the BCRS Deposit Mark are eligible for a refund.
The refund is S$0.10 per eligible container.
Containers without the mark remain recyclable through blue bins or other recycling stations.
The scheme product-approval guide distinguishes the product barcode from the separate square 2D traceability code printed on some approved labels.
